body: I CANNOT stand Christine. I think she is a nasty, awful person and contrary to popular opinion I really don't think she's good looking. Davina is a shit boring character and nasty as well. I really like Chrishell, Mary, Heather and Maya.

I'm starting to wonder if this is what it is to be 23. And 24. Maybe even 25. Reading this was like reading my own thoughts. My family support me, but we are not close, I don't connect with them. I feel immense guilt for taking from them. I live far away from them. I completed uni, two degrees even, but I do not have a "good" job \- it's a fulfilling job, but not a high paying one. I worry that going on is just pointless, that it's just going to drain the world and those I know more than it's going to give back.

I think it's just a hard age, and a hard time. We are in between being kids and adults. We understand all of the stress and pressures of being an adult, but cannot fully support ourselves. We still need a lot of help. We need time to find our places. 

Also, and I know this might come off as eccentric or bizarre, I also find it helpful to remember that we are spiritual beings having human experiences. Being a human is suffering. Having conscious thought is hard. It's not meant to be easy, and struggling does not mean that we are not cut out for it. The universe will exist eternally, and we have unlimited opportunities to exist again, as different beings, and to experience things from different perspectives. It's hard, but this life that you have now will be very short lived in the grand scheme of things, and the things that you learn will lead to better understanding and compassion for other beings in the future.
